essence: Arjuna requests Kṛṣṇa to define five key terms.
Adhiyajña and knowability at death stand questioned; the Lord's nine-question discourse resolves all but the final: how adhiyajña stands in the body.
Supreme Brahman is called the inner self and emission because its unbounded consciousness-power manifests all beings, states, and truths.
The perishable, divine, and sacrificial principles are identified; the departure-time question waits on determination.
Remembering the Lord alone at death leads to his state.
